Description: SB 330 Preliminary Application, proposes to demolish the existing 3 structures on-site at 1776-1790 University. Proposes to construct a five-story, mixed-use building (approximately 33,500 sq ft.). There will be 17 units, each with 5-bedrooms. The proposed project will offer 2 units that are affordable to very low income households at 50% AMI or below. This new mixed used building will have approximately 782 sg ft of commercial space on the ground floor.
